attribution.text: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI); NOAA National Weather Service

provenance.notes: Two APIs: operation 'ncei' = https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/services/ (NCEI Access Data Service; its documentation page https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/support/access-data-service-api-user-documentation states no rate limit, no key, no licence, HTTPS only); operation 'nws' = https://api.weather.gov/ (NWS API: 'A User Agent is required to identify your application', e.g. '(myweatherapp.com, contact@myweatherapp.com)'; 'reasonable rate limits ... The rate limit is not public information'; exceeding it returns an error; cache-friendly design, grid lookups may be cached). The User-Agent requirement is the NWS's; NCEI states none. NWS information is in the public domain 'and may be used without charge for any lawful purpose' (weather.gov/disclaimer), provided it is not modified and presented as official, nor used to imply NOAA/NWS endorsement; credit not required. NCEI's open data policy places archived data in the US public domain; GHCN-Daily's metadata asks users to cite the dataset (a request). NWS operational issues: nco.ops@noaa.gov; NCEI contact: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/contact. Read 2026-11-10.
